title: Paper to JSON
mission: Turn fictional certification applications in mixed layouts into validated JSON records.
steps: Show each application's raw text next to an empty record with the eight fields.
Normalize dates written as 2026-05-03, 3 May 2026 or 03/05/2026 to ISO format.
Extract the fields from the form and table layouts.
Validate each record and list its problems: missing fields, unknown certification, too little experience, exam before submission.
checks: 03/05/2026 is read as 3 May, following the DD/MM rule in certifications.json.
Missing fields become null and are reported, never guessed.
Every application ends up valid or with a readable list of problems.
validation: Show a table of all six applications with their status and problems.
extension: Let an LLM extract the two letter-style applications, then run its JSON through the same validator.
hint: Do dates first: they are small, easy to test and full of traps. Invalid dates such as 31/02/2026 must give null.
